notes: Cash basis city (FY ends 2025-09-30). Governmental data from the Total column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Change in Fund Balances - Cash Basis (p4). Utility (Water, Sewer) lines are the business-type items. 'Licenses, fees and permits' 99,203 split using the fund columns on p4: General 41,149 and Keno 58,054 (keno/lottery). Grants and donations 50,758 and Debt service (48,274) are printed under Other financing sources (uses) below Total receipts/disbursements, so recorded as receipts/disbursements with outside_printed_total (debt service split principal 45,000 / interest and fees 3,274 from Bond Fund p9). The report's own roll-forward is off by 3 due to rounding (see report_discrepancies); ending_cash 904,773 is the p4 figure while p1/p3 print 904,771. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position total (memo) column (p1); its Total column prints Accounts payable as '-' though total liabilities includes 12,422 (taken from the business-type column); Bonds payable split into current 67,226 / noncurrent 1,446,559 from p5. Business-type: Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position (p6) total column; receipts = operating revenues 477,981 + interest income 316; disbursements = operating expenses plus interest expense 8,910 (total 850,597 also printed on p2); misc income 49,369 recorded as charges for services since the budget schedule (p10, utility sales 481,741 = revenues 477,981 + receivable change 3,760) treats it as utility sales. Proprietary cash flow statement (p7) exists but basis is cash, so proprietary is null. Detail: General Fund combining schedule (p11, department columns) used instead of the p8 General Fund budget schedule (same fund, less detailed: no budget_final captured); Keno column included; Bond Fund and proprietary funds from their budget schedules (p9, p10). Small differences of 1-2 dollars between printed totals and the sums of printed lines are report rounding. 2026-10-22 page-image review: governmental ending cash 904,773 (p4 roll-forward; p1/p3 cash 904,771), business-type roll-forward on net position 2,708,929 -> 2,336,629 (p6) with business-type cash 295,427 (p7, p1, p5); the CRA component unit (cash 464,656, net position (64,119)) is excluded from the primary government.
